<document id="disputes-subscriptions">
SubscriptionsˆthatˆkeepˆchargingˆIfˆaˆsubscriptionˆkeepsˆchargingˆyouˆafterˆyouˆcancelledˆit,ˆhere'sˆwhatˆtoˆdo.ˆ##ˆ1.ˆCancelˆwithˆtheˆmerchantˆCancelˆthroughˆtheˆmerchant'sˆwebsiteˆorˆapp,ˆandˆsaveˆtheˆconfirmationˆemailˆorˆaˆscreenshot.ˆFreezingˆyourˆcardˆdoesn'tˆstopˆrecurringˆpaymentsˆtoˆmerchantsˆyou'veˆalreadyˆauthorized.ˆ##ˆ2.ˆAskˆforˆaˆrefundˆContactˆtheˆmerchantˆwithˆyourˆcancellationˆconfirmationˆandˆaskˆthemˆtoˆrefundˆchargesˆmadeˆafterˆthatˆdate.ˆManyˆmerchantsˆwill.ˆ##ˆ3.ˆDisputeˆitˆIfˆtheˆmerchantˆwon'tˆrefundˆyou,ˆdisputeˆeachˆchargeˆmadeˆafterˆyouˆcancelled.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆCancelledˆbutˆstillˆcharged.ˆYouˆhaveˆ120ˆdaysˆfromˆeachˆtransactionˆdate.ˆ##ˆStoppingˆfutureˆchargesˆIfˆaˆmerchantˆkeepsˆchargingˆafterˆyouˆcancel,ˆyouˆcanˆreportˆtheˆcardˆlostˆandˆgetˆaˆnewˆnumber.ˆRecurringˆpaymentsˆtoˆtheˆoldˆnumberˆwillˆthenˆfail.ˆThereˆmayˆbeˆaˆreplacementˆfeeˆdependingˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆ##ˆFreeˆtrialsˆChargesˆafterˆaˆfreeˆtrialˆendedˆaren'tˆunauthorizedˆifˆyouˆgaveˆyourˆcardˆwhenˆsigningˆup.ˆCancelˆwithˆtheˆmerchantˆandˆaskˆforˆaˆrefund.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="card-freeze">
FreezingˆandˆunfreezingˆyourˆcardˆFreezingˆyourˆcardˆblocksˆnewˆpurchasesˆandˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆstraightˆaway.ˆIt'sˆtheˆfastestˆthingˆtoˆdoˆifˆyou'veˆmisplacedˆyourˆcardˆandˆthinkˆyouˆmightˆfindˆitˆagain.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆfreezeˆorˆunfreezeˆTapˆCards,ˆchooseˆtheˆcard,ˆandˆswitchˆFreezeˆcardˆon.ˆSwitchˆitˆoffˆtoˆunfreeze.ˆBothˆhappenˆinstantly,ˆandˆyouˆcanˆdoˆitˆasˆoftenˆasˆyouˆlike.ˆ##ˆWhatˆstillˆworksˆwhileˆfrozenˆ-ˆRecurringˆpaymentsˆtoˆmerchantsˆyou'veˆalreadyˆauthorized,ˆsuchˆasˆsubscriptionsˆ-ˆRefundsˆfromˆmerchantsˆ-ˆDepositsˆandˆincomingˆtransfersˆ-ˆYourˆvirtualˆcard,ˆwhichˆhasˆitsˆownˆfreezeˆswitchˆ##ˆFreezeˆorˆreportˆlost?ˆIfˆyou'reˆsureˆtheˆcardˆisˆgoneˆorˆstolen,ˆreportˆitˆlostˆorˆstolenˆinstead.ˆThatˆcancelsˆtheˆcardˆpermanentlyˆandˆletsˆyouˆorderˆaˆreplacement.ˆAˆfreezeˆisˆtemporaryˆandˆreversible.ˆ##ˆFreezeˆversusˆfraudˆlockˆIfˆtheˆappˆsaysˆyourˆcardˆisˆlockedˆbyˆTallowbrook,ˆthat'sˆaˆfraudˆlock,ˆnotˆaˆfreeze.ˆYouˆcan'tˆremoveˆaˆfraudˆlockˆwithˆtheˆfreezeˆswitch.ˆSeeˆ"WhyˆisˆmyˆcardˆlockedˆbyˆTallowbrook?".ˆSupportˆcanˆalsoˆfreezeˆorˆunfreezeˆyourˆcardˆforˆyouˆifˆyouˆaskˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="travel-card-abroad">
UsingˆyourˆcardˆabroadˆYourˆTallowbrookˆcardˆworksˆinˆmostˆcountries,ˆanywhereˆVisaˆisˆaccepted.ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆgoˆ-ˆKeepˆnotificationsˆonˆforˆtheˆappˆsoˆyouˆcanˆanswerˆfraudˆalertsˆquickly.ˆ-ˆMakeˆsureˆInternationalˆpurchasesˆisˆswitchedˆonˆunderˆCards,ˆthenˆControls.ˆ-ˆCheckˆyourˆplan'sˆforeignˆtransactionˆandˆinternationalˆATMˆfees.ˆ-ˆAddˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆtoˆyourˆphone'sˆwalletˆasˆaˆbackup.ˆ##ˆWhatˆitˆcostsˆPurchasesˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrencyˆcarryˆaˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆofˆ3%ˆonˆBasic,ˆ1%ˆonˆPlusˆandˆ0%ˆonˆPremium.ˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆabroadˆhaveˆtheirˆownˆinternationalˆATMˆfeeˆinstead.ˆ##ˆPayingˆinˆtheˆlocalˆcurrencyˆWhenˆaˆcardˆterminalˆasksˆwhetherˆtoˆpayˆinˆUSˆdollarsˆorˆtheˆlocalˆcurrency,ˆchooseˆtheˆlocalˆcurrency.ˆ##ˆIfˆyourˆcardˆisˆlostˆabroadˆFreezeˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆreportˆit.ˆStandardˆandˆexpeditedˆshippingˆonlyˆgoˆtoˆUSˆaddresses.ˆPremiumˆmembersˆcanˆgetˆanˆemergencyˆcardˆdeliveredˆabroad.ˆEveryoneˆelseˆcanˆkeepˆspendingˆwithˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆinˆaˆmobileˆwallet.ˆDoˆyouˆneedˆtoˆtellˆusˆyou'reˆtraveling?ˆNo.ˆSeeˆ"DoˆIˆneedˆaˆtravelˆnotice?".ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
